I have re-implemented FFmpeg's `libswscale` in Zig using portable `@Vector` SIMD inside `/app/swscale-impl/`, building into `/app/swscale-impl/zig-out/lib/libswscale_candidate.so`.

### Architecture & Key Optimizations
- **[`build.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/build.zig)**: Configured the shared library target with `.x86_64_v3` features (`AVX2`, `FMA`, `BMI2`, keeping `AVX-512` disabled for Valgrind/Callgrind compatibility).
- **[`src/types.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/types.zig)**:
  - Defined 128-bit and 256-bit portable `@Vector` types (`V16u8`, `V32u8`, `V16u16`, `V16i16`, `V8i32`, `V16i32`) and pixel format / subsampling helpers.
  - Implemented [`mulhuwU8Sh8`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/types.zig#L87-L94) and [`mulhuwU9Sh7`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/types.zig#L98-L105) to evaluate 16-bit unsigned high-multiply by compile-time constants purely in `<16 x u16>` without triggering 512-bit `<16 x i32>` widening in LLVM.
- **[`src/filter.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/filter.zig)**:
  - Implemented [`initFilter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/filter.zig#L47-L296) matching FFmpeg's `SWS_POINT`, `SWS_BILINEAR`, and `SWS_BICUBIC` 1D convolution filter construction, error diffusion, boundary clamping, and filter trimming.
  - Pre-transposed horizontal filter weights in 8-pixel SIMD blocks (`weights_t`) during `swscale_create` so the horizontal scaling hot loops load weights directly without runtime shuffles.
- **[`src/unscaled.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig)**:
  - Implemented 16-pixel-wide planar <-> packed RGB24/BGR24/RGBA/BGRA deinterleaving and interleaving ([`loadRgb24x16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig#L26-L49), [`storeRgb24x16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig#L67-L95), [`loadRgba32x16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig#L51-L65), [`storeRgba32x16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig#L97-L115)) using `@shuffle`.
  - Implemented vectorized unscaled converters across all 10 pixel formats, including 6-bit fixed-point YUV->RGB evaluation ([`computeChromaOffsets6Vec16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig#L197-L209), [`scaleLuma6Vec16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig#L211-L214), [`evalYuv6ChannelVec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig#L216-L218)) and single-pass 2-row fused RGB->YUV420P/NV12/NV21 conversion ([`rgbToYuv420OrNv`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/unscaled.zig#L469-L547)).
- **[`src/scaled.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig)** & **[`src/main.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/main.zig)**:
  - Vectorized [`hScale8To15`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig#L15-L185), [`hScale14To15`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig#L187-L370), and [`hScaleRgb3Row`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig#L473-L645) using contiguous multi-tap loads (`u16`/`u32`) and pre-transposed filter weights, plus vectorized vertical ring-buffer scaling ([`vScale15To8Row`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig#L372-L426), [`scaleRgbDirect`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig#L647-L746), [`scaleRgbDown2x`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig#L838-L966), and [`scaleGeneral`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig#L990-L1214)).
  - Fused luma and chroma RGB row unpacking ([`computeRowYUV14Half`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-couolvy2/swscale-impl/src/scaled.zig#L750-L820)) during scaled RGB->YUV conversions so each source row is unpacked once.
